predicate.description: A typed applicability predicate over a selected standard's domain facts and future externally observed target facts.

canonical_path.description: Repository-relative path of this standard YAML document. Canonical standards end in .standard.yaml; shadow candidates end in .candidate.yaml. Renderers use this explicit identity and must not infer it from the standard ID.

render_mode.description: Semantic mode renders typed item headings and annotations. Source-faithful mode renders leaf source blocks continuously under their family headings.

domain_facts.description: Complete scalar facts guaranteed whenever this standard is selected. Every direct import's domain facts must be a type-exact subset. Target-observed facts are external to the document and may supplement but never contradict this domain.

imports.description: Imports are pinned references, not inheritance. Imported items cannot be overwritten in place; use local exceptions, replacement assertions, supersedes, or conflicts-with links.

source_units.description: Optional conversion-audit slices of retained migration sources. Remove them, and imported origins that cite them, after the normalized standard becomes canonical.

instruction_id.description: A nonempty label for the relevant instruction within the artifact. It is not a resolved or executable LLM interface identifier.

semantic_reviews.description: Relevant human/LLM semantic evaluation definitions, never review outcomes.

additionalProperties.description: Only JSON Schema artifacts are supported as authorities.

effect.description: Use narrow when the imported assertion remains effective for this standard, but only within narrowed_applicability.

replacement.description: Prefer one independently assessable normative claim whenever practical.

narrowed_applicability.description: Required only for effect narrow. The imported assertion remains effective in this standard exactly within this typed applicability predicate. It does not modify the imported standard.

applies_when.description: Optional applicability predicate. Descendants inherit ancestor predicates by conjunction. Missing facts evaluate to unknown, never false.
Optional applicability predicate inherited by the rule's assertions. Missing facts evaluate to unknown, never false.
Optional assertion applicability predicate, conjoined with its rule and ancestor-family predicates. Missing facts evaluate to unknown, never false.

replacement.description: Prefer one independently assessable normative claim whenever practical.

items.description: Prefer one independently assessable normative claim whenever practical.

applies_when.description: Optional guidance applicability predicate, conjoined with ancestor-family predicates. Missing facts evaluate to unknown, never false.

oneOf.description: non-normative explanation, navigation, or application help. If deviation can be reported as noncompliance, use a recommended assertion.

applies_when.description: Optional procedure applicability predicate, conjoined with ancestor-family predicates. Missing facts evaluate to unknown, never false.
